family.account.title: Your account
family.account.body: Your household backs up here, so a new phone gets it back when you sign in. Document photos stay on this phone.
family.account.signedOut: Signed out. Everything stays on this phone.
family.delete.title: Delete your account?
family.delete.body: Deletes its backup, email and name from Manendi’s server now. This phone keeps its data. Manendi Plus keeps billing until you cancel it in your {store} settings.
family.erase.all.title: Erase everything?
family.erase.all.body: Deletes every person, date, trip, document and case on this phone, plus what Manendi’s server holds. This can’t be undone.
family.erase.server.title: Erase your server data?
family.erase.server.body: Deletes your watched cases and this device’s record from Manendi’s server now. Your dates on this phone stay.
family.erase.server.bodyAccount: Deletes your watched cases, your account and its backup and this device’s record from Manendi’s server now. Your dates on this phone stay.

family.backup.title: Back up your household
family.backup.body: Optional. Sign in to get everyone’s dates and cases back on any phone. Document photos never leave this one.
